gaps.reason: Pi defaults thinkingLevel to "off" when the branch has no thinking_level_change entry; octet stores no level, so resume falls back to the configured default (app/bootstrap.rs persisted_session_config).

Pi defaults thinkingLevel to "off" when the branch has no thinking_level_change entry; octet stores no level, so resume falls back to the configured default (app/bootstrap.rs persisted_session_config).
Pi keeps a setup-only session in memory and writes no file until the first user/assistant message; octet creates the JSONL and appends setup entries immediately (octet-agent session/store.rs create).
Pi records append-only context_edit entries that replace or omit an earlier entry's model content; octet has no such EntryValue and refuses the operation.
Pi stores system and bashExecution messages as session entries; octet's Message has only user/assistant, with tool results carried inside user content.
Pi exposes appendUsage for arbitrary categories; octet has no appendable model-attributed usage entry, only per-operation ledger records written by the agent loop.

octet refuses an empty branch summary, a branch summary whose details object omits readFiles/modifiedFiles (both fields are required by CompactionDetails), and branch-with-summary on an empty session; Pi accepts all three (octet-agent session.rs validate_branch_summary, compaction.rs CompactionDetails).

octet refuses empty-retention compaction (firstKeptEntryId equal to the compaction id) and a details object that omits readFiles/modifiedFiles (both required by CompactionDetails); Pi accepts both (octet-agent session/context.rs compact, compaction.rs CompactionDetails).

octet's Pi importer refuses custom entries, context_edit, bashExecution/system messages, non-cache_warm usage, the openai-responses API, Anthropic thinking signatures and empty-retention compaction (session_commands/pi.rs).
